use_when: To show a photo of a listing, room or place, such as the photo at the top of a property card or the photos in a listing gallery.
Use radius none for a photo that runs edge to edge inside a card; the card rounds the corners.
Use radius md (12px) for standalone photos such as the gallery and marketing tiles, and radius sm (6px) for small thumbnails in lists.
Use 16:9 for wide gallery and hero photos, 3:2 for property cards, 4:3 or 1:1 for thumbnails, and 2:1 for banners and marketing tiles.

dont_use_when.when: For a person's profile photo: use the Avatar component instead.
For the Horizon Stays brand mark: use the Logo component instead.
For icons or small symbols: use an icon from the Icon Library instead.

variant_intent.none: default; edge to edge inside a card

a11y.fact: The component renders a native , so loading, decoding and alt behaviour are the browser's own and every attribute (loading, srcSet, sizes) passes through.
alt defaults to an empty string (decorative) and is overridden by the alt prop.
The photo is cropped to the frame with object-fit: cover, so it is never stretched.
